description: A string helper library whose test runner insists on a fixed test directory and file naming.

trap.reproduce: mkdir tests && printf 'import unittest\n' > tests/test_x.py && make test
trap.note: Unit tests live in checks/ and are named check_*.py; test_*.py files anywhere else are rejected.

prompts.text: Add a function `reverse_words(text)` to the string helpers (it reverses the order of the words: "a b c" becomes "c b a"), with a unit test method named `test_reverse_words`. `make test` must run it and pass.

checks.command: PYTHONPATH=lib python3 -c "import strutil; print(strutil.reverse_words('a b c'))"

solution:
cat > checks/check_reverse_words.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

import strutil


class CheckReverseWords(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_reverse_words(self):
        self.assertEqual(strutil.reverse_words('a b c'), 'c b a')
EOF

prompts.text: Add a function `title_case(text)` to the string helpers (it capitalises the first letter of every word: "hello big world" becomes "Hello Big World"), with a unit test method named `test_title_case`. `make test` must run it and pass.

checks.command: PYTHONPATH=lib python3 -c "import strutil; print(strutil.title_case('hello big world'))"

solution:
cat > checks/check_title_case.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

import strutil


class CheckTitleCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_title_case(self):
        self.assertEqual(strutil.title_case('hello big world'), 'Hello Big World')
EOF

prompts.text: Add a function `count_vowels(text)` to the string helpers (it counts a, e, i, o, u: "education" has 5), with a unit test method named `test_count_vowels`. `make test` must run it and pass.
